actions.action: Enforce expiry independently of configuration refreshes
actions.mechanism: Gate every displayed item by local time, including announcements already on screen when connectivity disappears.
actions.implementation: Hide timestamped items when local time reaches expiry minus 30 seconds; schedule removal independently of playback. Exempt explicit-until-revoked items.
actions.check: Test six-hour outages at both clock-error bounds, including expiry during playback; verify no timestamped item remains visible after true expiry.
actions.risk: Conservative enforcement can hide items up to 60 seconds early.

actions.action: Reject configurations that could resurrect removed revisions
actions.mechanism: Monotonic configuration generations and authoritative replacement prevent stale reconnect responses from restoring deleted items.
actions.implementation: Persist the accepted generation; reject older or conflicting equal-generation bundles. Replace complete item sets, never merge. Server-side deletion records forbid republishing removed revisions.
actions.check: Replay pre-removal bundles after removal, reconnect, and reboot; verify removed revisions remain absent and the accepted generation never decreases.
actions.risk: Generation resets or lost persistent state require explicit recovery handling.

actions.action: Stage and commit complete bundles atomically
actions.mechanism: Keep incomplete reconnect transfers isolated from the active configuration; expose only fully validated replacements.
actions.implementation: Stage separately; reject bundles of 100 KB or larger, duplicate IDs, and invalid validity fields. Atomically commit contents with generation; keep expiry enforcement running.
actions.check: Interrupt downloads and cut power at each commit step; require either complete previous or complete new state, never mixed contents and generation.
actions.risk: Staging needs additional storage; oversized configurations require publication-time rejection.

actions.action: Show the limits of offline freshness
actions.mechanism: Separate expiry enforcement from revocation knowledge so cached announcements are not presented as freshly confirmed.
actions.implementation: Display last successful synchronization time and: “Cached announcements; expiry enforced. Offline removals cannot be received; until-revoked announcements may remain.” Clear only after successful synchronization.
actions.check: Disconnect for six hours, revoke an item remotely, and reconnect without completing synchronization; verify the warning remains and accurately describes visible content.
actions.risk: Warnings need readable placement without obscuring public announcements.
